notes.title: Patch Notes for 5/19/25
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] When using one of the "Delete All" shortcuts from the context menu, you will now be presented with a confirmation pop-up to confirm you would indeed like to actually delete all tokens, maps, drawings, etc. This is to prevent you from accidentally deleting lots of things when you were in fact trying to just create a note or token. If you find this to be annoying, you can disable the pop-ups in the preferences section of the settings.
[*] At some point, the website that hosted the reference documentation for using the Dice Roller went offline, so the link from GATE led to a dead website. Thanks to the Internet Archive's Wayback Machine, I was able to recover the documentation and host it on Banshee Cat's servers instead. The button now redirects there instead.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 3/24/25
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added support for Thai characters.
[/list]
Is your language of choice not supported by GATE? Reach out on Discord or the Steam community forums and we'll see what we can do!

notes.title: Patch Notes for 1/20/25
notes.notes:
Happy 2025 everyone! Starting the year off with a small fix.
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug preventing DMs from interacting with elements in the Monsters tool.
[/list]

notes.title: Last update for 2024!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, as we round out the year I'm happy to add a couple fixes for GATE before the year closes out.

It was requested that an input field be added to the drawing tools, so users can explicitly set the width of lines and shapes. This allows users to be more consistent with their drawings if the size is changing throughout the session.  This is now available!  Have your own requests you'd like to see for GATE? Drop your feedback in our Discord or on the Steam community forums.

An issue with how fog is saved in certain scenarios has been addressed, and so fog should be more consistent in how it's persisted between sessions. If you have issues with loading fog from a previous save, please reach out!

Thanks for using GATE this year, here's hoping to some fun improvements in 2025! :)

notes.title: Patch Notes for 8/11/24
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue causing the Select All and Deselect All buttons to not work with Map and Gallery collections.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 8/8/24
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] When adding images to an artwork collection, drag and dropping images no longer creates maps instead of adding those images to your collection.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented users from drag and dropping images into a Gallery collection.
[*] Fixed a bug that created duplicate collection names in the dropdown list when managing maps and artwork in the new Gallery tool.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 1/20/24
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where saving a session could result in map rotations being saved incorrectly.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 1/14/24
notes.notes:
Greetings! A new patch for the new year.

[list]
[*] Added a 'Streaming Mode' that lets you hide all hidden tokens and maps on your screen for moments when you may be sharing your screen with others. It's accessible by hotkey with the default keybinding being 'M'
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented 3D models added to your library from automatically generating a 2D preview image.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 11/26/23
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] In the event the matchmaking server is down, GATE will now prompt users to connect to a host directly via IP Address. This functionality will only work if the host has port forwarded UDP traffic on port 42069.
[*] Previous Usernames can now be deleted with the trash can icon on the top right of the preview image.
[*] Maps now have two additional context items when right clicking. You can choose 'Set Size' to explicitly define how many grid squares a map should take up. You can also 'Snap Position' to snap the map to the grid. This works best when the map dimensions are whole numbers.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 9/11/23
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the AC from displaying in monster stat blocks.
[*] Fixed a header in the Custom Monsters panel that implied the window was for Custom Spells.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 8/19/23
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] If a token has a max health greater than zero, and a current health of zero, it will display a Skull & Crossbones above the token to signify that it's dead. This behavior can be toggled in the preferences menu.
[*] Added an additional field for custom monsters and spells to more easily allow importing of data that falls outside D&D systems. All fields are now optional (except name) and only displayed if they contain a value.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented right clicking icons on the toolbar. This allows you to easily see the name of the app and optionally remove it from the quick start bar.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the hamburger icon to turn to an X and never turn back after clicking the icon at top left of any window.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 7/27/23
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused unresponsive UI in the case that available monitor resolutions didn't match the available monitor resolutions from the last time the game was launched.
[/list]

notes.title: More Patch Notes for 7/08/23
notes.notes:
While pushing the earlier patch I noticed that fog wasn't loading from saved files correctly. So without further delay:
[list]
[*] Fog is now loaded correctly when loading a saved session.
[/list]

I did notice that the whole save/load process for fog assumes that you:
[olist]
[*] Start with a map full of fog.
[*] Remove/add fog as needed as your players explore.
[/olist]

If you start with a blank slate, then add fog by hand, you'll notice your save game loads completely blanketed with fog. This is a known issue I'll try to address soon in the future.

notes.title: Patch Notes for 7/08/23
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue preventing maps from properly displaying when loading a saved game.
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented a game from loading properly when in offline mode.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 7/06/23
notes.notes:
[list]

[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 6/26/23
notes.notes:

notes.title: Patch Notes for 4/20/23

notes.title: Patch Notes for 4/01/23
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the game to hang when loading certain save files.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused connection issues when joining sessions.

notes.title: Patch Notes for 3/21/23

notes.title: Patch Notes for 3/17/23
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug preventing tokens from using the Y axis on the gizmo.
[*] Fixed a bug that was cutting the output from the measurement tool in half for players.

notes.title: Patch Notes for 3/15/23

[list]

[/list]

notes.notes:

notes.title: Patch Notes for 3/12/23
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added around 70 new pieces of sci-fi themed token art to the included content.
[*] Added a Mouse Sensitivity slider to the settings.
[*] Added a Camera Speed slider to the settings.

notes.title: Patch Notes for 3/11/23
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug preventing saved games from being loaded if they contained a token that didn't have a skin attached to it.
[*] Setting token visibility now correctly hides 3D tokens.
[*] Changing token artwork now properly clears the previous token artwork for clients, preventing artwork from stacking on top of each other.

[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 3/09/23
notes.notes:
[h2]Thank You![/h2]
A big thanks to those of you who have had a chance to give the latest update a try and share your feedback and bug reports. Thanks to you, the following issues have been resolved.
[list]
[*] When loading games, a token's base visibility is now loaded correctly.
[*] Snap to Grid now works for all drawing shapes.
[*] Removing a favorite from the Monsters or Spellbook apps no longer removes the entire entry.
[*] Straight Lines can now be erased from any part of the line, not just the tip.
[*] Shortcut keys for adding and removing fog now work properly without the Fog window needing to be open.
[/list]

Additionally, the following changes have been made based on feedback.
[list]
[*] The current tool selected is now displayed at the top of the screen instead of in the Drawing Tools. This allows you to keep track of what mode you're in even if windows are closed.
[*] Added new keybinds for clearing/resetting fog, adding tokens, and opening the quick menu.
[/list]

Lastly, the default artwork from the last generation of GATE has been removed. It was created by a personal friend of mine, and its home now resides on the Workshop! This prevents duplicate artwork from showing up in your collections if you're subscribing to his other content.

If you'd like to get the old artwork back, just subscribe to his content [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561197990832581/myworkshopfiles/?appid=1689250]here[/url].
Some of the earliest content is available [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/alderex/myworkshopfiles/?appid=1689250]here instead[/url]. If you find that you're missing some token art that was provided previously and isn't available on the workshop, reach out!

notes.title: Patch Notes for 10/11/2022
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Images can now be dragged and dropped onto GATE during a session to display the image as a map.
[*] On most windows, tab should cycle between input fields, and enter should submit the content. If you find a window where that's not the case, please submit a bug report.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 10/05/22
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Token base colors can now be changed in the advanced options.
[*] Token artwork scale can now be changed in the advanced options.
[*] Tokens now have a colored ring around them to indicate the owner of the token.
[*] A bug has been fixed that prevented new collections from being used without restarting the application.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 8/11/22
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Users can no longer interact with the world while a window is open. This prevents accidental drawings and other unintentional actions.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 8/04/22
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] While adding or removing fog, the scroll wheel now changes the size of the brush. The brush is not incredibly accurate when very small.
[*] Tokens now have an advanced settings panel, where you can explicitly set its position in the world, in addition to the position and rotation of the model.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 7/10/22
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Token size and aura size can now easily be increased or decreased by one unit using new buttons.
[*] Favorite rolls can now be edited.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 6/08/22
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] A new Bug Report option has been included to help users submit bug reports.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 5/30/22
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Tokens now have their size set explicitly, allowing for more precise control over tokens.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 5/26/22
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Token height is no longer restricted to whole numbers, enabling precise placement for props.
[*] Locked tokens now no longer show the height indicator, allowing for floating props.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 5/07/22
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug preventing the game from being saved when utilizing 3D models.
[*] The measurement tool output now has a background to help read the text.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 5/03/2022
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Tokens can now be locked. This locks them into their position and prevents them from being clicked on. Select the token with a mouse drag to remove the lock.
[*] Tokens can now be hidden. This allows for tokens to be invisible to other players for any reason.
[*] Tokens can now have their token bases hidden. This is beneficial if tokens are being used for environment props or have their own 3D bases.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 4/21/2022
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Token and map art is now loaded on demand rather than the start of the application. This prevents GATE from crashing if you have over 50 or so maps in your collections.
[*] Token and map preview images are now generated thumbnails instead of full size images to reduce memory used by GATE.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 4/7/2022
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Tokens no longer appear selected even when they aren't.
[*]  Fog synchronization has been optimized.
[*]  Joining sessions should now be more reliable.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 4/6/2022
notes.notes: Thickness has been added back to token bases due to popular demand.

notes.title: Patch Notes for 4/5/2022
notes.notes:
Fixes mostly relating to the new 3D update.

[list]
[*] The collection dropdown in the Skin selection window is now properly anchored where it needs to be.
[*] The UI can no longer be interacted with while it's hidden.
[*] Scaling for models has been tweaked to properly handle models with multiple meshes.
[*] Token bases have been flattened to avoid them getting tall when the size is large.
[*] Token heights are now properly displayed when selected.
[*] Auras are now more accurately displayed on the grid.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 3/27/2022
notes.notes: Players can no longer create or reset fog with hotkeys. This functionality is limited to the DMs.

notes.title: Patch Notes for 1/26/22
notes.notes:
[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Tokens can now have their orientation changed, to lay down flat on the map.
[*] A new 2D mode has been added that changes the game view to top down.
[/list]
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Changes have been made to prevent GATE from acting as if the mouse if being held down when the game loses and regains focus.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 1/6/22
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the 'View Fog as Player' and 'Snap to Grid' options to overlap in the UI as the host.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 1/5/22
notes.notes:
[h1]Complete Overhaul to the Dice Roller![/h1]
[list]
[*] The dice rolling parser has been completely replaced.
[*] Dice rolls now support complex logic, including exploding dice, rerolling, and keeping high/low values.
[*] A link to the reference guide has been added to the Favorite Rolls window. 
[/list]
[url=https://skizzerz.net/DiceRoller/Dice_Reference]View the reference guide to the new dice functionality here![/url]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 1/1/22
notes.notes:
Happy New Year! To bring it in we have two feature requests that have been added.

[list]
[*] Drawings can now snap to grid when using a square grid. Support for other grid types may be added down the line.
[*] Tokens are now rotated at smaller increments for further precision. 
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 12/13/21
notes.notes:
[h1]Enhancements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Images can now be shared by the DM and viewed by players. This is useful for showing off clues the players come across, or showing off a high resolution picture of an NPC.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Drawings are now drawn on a 2D flat plane and no longer rotate to face the camera.
[*] Refreshing available skins no longer doubles entries in the filter dropdown.
[*] Fixed Forcecage SRD content.
[*] Fixed Prismatic Wall SRD content.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 11/30/21
notes.notes:
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Tokens now maintain their aspect ratio when converted into 3D meshes. This means that token art will no longer be squashed and stretched to fit into a square space.
[*] Token art previews in the browser are no longer stretched to fit a square aspect ratio.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 11/26/21
notes.notes:
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] The alpha threshold used when creating 3D meshes from token art has been tweaked to work better with high resolution images.
[*] Tokens in the workshop can now be as large as 500 KB.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 11/17/21
notes.notes:
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]  Multiselect now works as expected regardless of orientation.
[*]  Token options are now hidden automatically when more than one token is selected.
[*]  The Reset Fog and Hide Fog hotkeys are now no longer triggered when typing.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 11/15/21
notes.notes:
[h1]Enhancements
[/h1]
[list]
[*] DMs can now view fog from the players perspective.
[*] Hotkeys added to add fog and remove fog.
[*] Demo users can now host private sessions to try out DM functionality in a limited environment.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Changes have been made to prevent player input from affecting the game when it's no longer in focus.
[*] Rotating the camera is now smoother on the start of the rotation.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the hide UI function to cause weird behavior.
[*] The feedback form now properly wraps text.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 11/05/21
notes.notes:
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] The Toggle Grid functionality is now fixed.
[*] The Toggle Grid functionality is now handled by the DM, with the visibility syncing down to players.
[/list]

notes.title: More Patch Notes for 11/03/21
notes.notes:
[h1]Enhancements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Maps and layers are now optimized before being sent to players, resulting in up to 80% smaller file sizes. This should increase network performance.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 11/03/21
notes.notes:
[h1]Enhancements[/h1]
[list]
[*] DMs can now change the grid color under Environment options.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Network messages have been optimized to hopefully reduce the amount of times that a map doesn't sync to connected players.
[*] The grid should now be more visible when viewed on top of a map.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 11/01/21
notes.notes:
[h1]Enhancements[/h1]
[list]
[*] The feedback option now includes a field for an email address so I can contact those who use it as a place to report problems.
[*] Maps now maintain their scale and offset when reloading them later in the session.
[/list]
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed players to draw even if the DM disabled player drawing.
[*] Fixed a bug that broke map functionality when using images outside of a collection.
[*] The DM menu has been slightly extended to remove the need for a scroll bar.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 10/24/21
notes.notes:
[h1]Enhancements[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Maps now have easier to use sizes. Each unit represents one square on the grid.
[*] Maps can now be offset from their origin to align better with the grid.
[*] DM's can now prevent players from drawing.
[/olist]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Hexes on the hex grid have been reduced in size. They now measure 5ft in diameter. Tokens have been scaled down 25% to compensate.
[/olist]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 10/20/21
notes.notes:
[h1]Enhancements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Maps can now have layers. These layers are useful if you want to overlay a secret room or reveal rooms as players explore. For best results, ensure your layers are the same resolution as your base image.
[*] Grid types can now be changed by the DM. In addition to a standard square grid, you can now use a hex grid or an offset-square grid.
[/list]

[h1]In Progress[/h1]
[list]
[*] A way to offset the position of maps
[/list]

Have suggestions on features you think would improve GATE? Please let us know via the Feedback option in game or stop by our Discord!

notes.title: Patch Notes for 10/14/21
notes.notes:
A big thanks to those of you who have given feedback over the last couple weeks!

[h1]Enhancements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Maps should now be loaded around 50% faster than before.
[*] Map and token art is now cached to improve network performance. Loading maps a second time should be almost instantaneous.
[*] The technology handling line generation has been completely replaced, so your drawings should look smoother than ever before.
[*] Clicking the compass in the bottom right of the screen now resets your camera orientation.
[*] Maps can have their sizes more finely tuned to more accurately match the grid spacing in game.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 9/28/21
notes.notes:
[h1]Enhancements[/h1]
Tokens now have a small arrow, indicating their current direction. This is useful if you're playing a system where character facing is important.

notes.title: Patch Notes for 8/15/21
notes.notes:
[h2]Enhancements[/h2]
Browsing your available tokens and maps has never been easier.  New dropdown lists let you select which collections you'd like to view.

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
Maps were not being properly synced between players due to buffer restraints. Allocations have been increased, and maps should now properly sync between players.

notes.title: Patch Notes for 8/05/21
notes.notes:
A big thank you to the players who have had the opportunity to upload their own token collections to the Workshop!  Thanks to you, it was discovered that there was a problem with the UI that occurred when subscribed to more than four collections.  As such, the following fixes have been made.

[olist]
[*] Subscriptions can now properly be viewed in the Workshop when more than four have been subscribed to.
[*] Collections now have a bigger area to display descriptions, allowing more text to be seen than before.
[*] Tips have been added to the main screen, showing some shortcut keys until a full control configuration page is added.
[/olist]
Thanks again to all the players making content for the game, hopefully GATE is working well for your campaigns!

notes.title: Patch Notes for 7/31/21
notes.notes:
Thanks to some feedback from early adopters, some quality of life updates have been added:
[olist]
[*] Collections can now be deleted.
[*] Using the arrow keys, you can cycle through previous chat entries.
[*] The spellbook and monsters windows can now be dragged around.
[/olist]

As always, if you have any suggestions for further changes, let us know!

notes.title: Patch Notes for 7/30/21
notes.notes: It's launch day, which means that problems are going to come up last minute. Luckily this was a small one. There was a problem with the UI in regards to picking colors for your username, but that's now been solved! I hope everything else runs smoothly, and if you run into problems, please let us know on Discord, the Steam forums, or via the feedback option in game.
